programme.title: Koyelaanchal
programme.desc: An honest IAS officer rises against the atrocities of a brutal mafioso. In retaliation, the mafioso sends a deadly human weapon to kill the officer, who instead ends up abducting his child.

programme.title: Aar Ya Paar
programme.desc: Shekhar is having an affair with Anu, his wealthy wife's secretary. When the wife finds out, they kill her. The police then find evidence against him, and he learns that Anu is likely to betray him.

programme.title: Blue Oranges
programme.desc: When a wealthy alcoholic turns up dead, Detective Nilesh investigates the murder by interrogating various suspects that include her former lover, a spoilt brat and the commissioner's brother.

programme.title: Star
programme.desc: Dev, an ambitious singer, wishes to become a star like Elvis Presley. But, his middle-class life compels him to give up on his dreams, until he finds a job with Charlie's Disco which changes his life.

programme.title: Sultanat
programme.desc: Sultan, a brave warrior, tries to win the affections of Yasmin, a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside-down when his father is killed by a general who he then swears revenge against.

programme.title: Apartment
programme.desc: Preeti, an air hostess, is tired of her unfaithful boyfriend and decides to throw him out of the house. To share the rent, she finds a roommate who appears to be a simple girl but has her own agenda.

programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara
programme.desc: Inspector Jai arrests Guman only to release him after he threatens to destroy the city. Later, Jai's brother, who has a cognitive disability, gets abducted in return for a mysterious bag.

programme.title: Daraar
programme.desc: Raj Malhotra, a wealthy man, falls in love with Priya Bhatia, a real estate agent, as soon as he meets her. When he proposes to her for marriage, he discovers that she is already married.

programme.title: Johny I Love You
programme.desc: Suraj Singh, a former bandit, relocates to a small hillside after the death of his wife, Savitri. He changes his son Raju's name to Johny to save him from the wrath of his former partner.

programme.title: Devta
programme.desc: Balram, a rogue, who works for crime lord Bajrang decides to kill inspector Rakesh for sending him to prison. However, he changes his mind when he learns a secret about Rakesh.

programme.title: Marshal
programme.desc: A young man puts his life on the line to investigate a hospital run by a crime syndicate that performs various unethical procedures on helpless patients.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love
programme.desc: Rajveer, a rich man, falls in love with Madhuri. However, he soon realises that she detests affluent people and in order to win her heart, he, along with his family, pretends to be poor.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Mafia Raaj
programme.desc: An honest police officer has a mission to wipe out a mafia group. But in the process, he is forced to sacrifice not only his father but also his sister.

programme.title: Keemat
programme.desc: Two crooks accidentally kill a man and decide to inform his parents about the bad news. However, once they meet the family, they end up lying to them.

programme.desc: Hearing: Whether through the air or through water, some animals have evolved to perceive changes in their environment through the sense of hearing. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Secret Life Of The Wombat
programme.desc: Wombat Wood: The humble wombat shares a common ancestor with the koala but is far less well known than its fellow Australian. But how do these elusive creatures live? (Ep 1 of 2)

programme.title: Secret Life Of The Wombat
programme.desc: Joey's Journey: For wombats, the mating season is a break from their solitary lives. Despite their timidness, their behaviour here can be amazingly energetic. (Ep 2 of 2)

programme.title: Survival Of The Beast
programme.desc: Leopard: Max Djenohan embarks on a mission to unlock and mimic the survival skills of some of the most charismatic animals on Earth. (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: Over Australia
programme.desc: Arid Heart: From the vast, dry plains of the interior come some of Australia's iconic imagery, such as the monolithic red rock of Uluru and the bounding red kangaroo. (1 of 2)

programme.title: Over Australia
programme.desc: The Great Divide: Created by titanic forces and spanning thousands of miles along the eastern edge of Australia, the Great Dividing Range separates two very different worlds. (2 of 2)

programme.title: Extreme Africa
programme.desc: Dragon Mountain - Surviving the Summit: Meet a new species of exotic animals perfectly suited to inhabit the mighty Drakensberg, one of South Africa's most impressive landscapes. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Airborne
programme.desc: Catching Air: Novice fliers tackle their first ascents, earth-bound creatures soar uniquely and sky masters race with speed, power and agility. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Whale With Steve Backshall
programme.desc: Whales and Us: Steve Backshall explores our changing understanding of whales, how much we have in common with them and how we can better protect them. (1 of 4)

programme.title: Whale With Steve Backshall
programme.desc: Ocean Hunters: Steve encounters the largest hunters on the planet, revealing how their ingenious hunting strategies can cause trouble. (2 of 4)

programme.title: Humanlike: The Chimps of Fongoli
programme.desc: Watch evolution happen in real time as the elusive chimps of Fongoli, Senegal, learn to use tools, interact with fire and adapt to the human world.

programme.title: New: Wolves & Lions: Old Enemies
programme.desc: Ancient Enemies: In Africa, lions and wolves lead their ecosystems. Discover the strength, social strategies and hierarchies behind how they raise and protect their young. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: David Attenborough's First Life
programme.desc: Arrival: Sir David Attenborough goes in search of the very first animals to inhabit our planet - a journey that begins in a forest near his childhood home in Leicester. (1 of 2)

programme.title: David Attenborough's First Life
programme.desc: Conquest: Sir David Attenborough explores the beautiful landscapes of Canada's Rocky Mountains, where fossils document an explosion in animal diversity. (2 of 2)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Bachelor King
programme.desc: Filmed on the sub-Antarctic island of South Georgia over a period of five months, Sir David Attenborough's immersive documentary explores the extraordinary lives of king penguins.

programme.title: Humanlike: The Chimps of Fongoli
programme.desc: Watch evolution happen in real time as the elusive chimps of Fongoli, Senegal, learn to use tools, interact with fire and adapt to the human world.
